prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adopt Stage Grid Redesign with Live Pet Preview: Redesign the pet selection screen into a full visual grid showcasing live interactive pet animations alongside photo options. (why: Adoption has a 68.5% conversion rate with a long median time of 89s, and users reported issues during pet generation.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Quick Controls Card Screen: Add a dedicated controls walkthrough screen right before finishing that explains how to summon, hide, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: Finish drops to 64.8% conversion and 3 support emails reported confusion around pet controls after setup.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Early Account Sync Verification Step: Reorder sign-in flow to emphasize cloud pet sync status immediately upon viewing the screen. (why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive Generation Engine Flow: Transform the waiting screen into a dynamic two-column rendering flow with live engine status progress. (why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s and users report pets failing to spawn on desktop.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Path Explorer Fast Track Hint: Add an explicit helper hint explaining the instant preset vs custom photo creation paths. (why: Mean time spent on path selection is high at 514s.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Engine Completion Sound Alert: Play a subtle audio notification when desktop rendering finishes on the waiting screen. (why: High mean waiting duration (2336s) causes users to alt-tab away and miss when onboarding completes.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Recovery Banner Hint: Display explicit account recovery instructions below the sign in fields. (why: 8 emails reported losing pet progress when signing in on a new device or re-logging.)
7: [finish, layout] Desktop Launch Split Layout: Switch home intro to a split view layout with an animated pet mascot and prominent launch button. (why: Finish step drop-off is 64.8% with an average time of 5815s.)
8: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Status Check Banner: Display a live system status message verifying desktop overlay compatibility while waiting. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet failing to appear on the desktop after onboarding.)
